CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_gigs" (

  "buyout" REAL,
  "catering" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "check_in" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "costs" REAL,
  "created_at" TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')) NOT NULL,
  "date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "deal_notes" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "deal_type" TEXT DEFAULT 'festgage' NOT NULL,
  "deposit" REAL,
  "diesel_price" REAL,
  "distance_km" REAL,
  "door_percent" REAL,
  "drinks" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "duration_min" INTEGER,
  "expected_attendance" INTEGER,
  "fee" REAL,
  "gema_reported" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "hospitality_notes" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "input_list_sent" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "invoice_status" TEXT DEFAULT 'offen' NOT NULL,
  "notes" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "people" INTEGER,
  "petrol_price" REAL,
  "rent" REAL,
  "return_km" REAL,
  "return_min" INTEGER,
  "rider_sent" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sound_engineer_id" TEXT,
  "stage_plot_sent" INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT DEFAULT 'anfrage' NOT NULL,
  "tech_notes" TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "ticket_door" REAL,
  "ticket_presale" REAL,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "tolls" REAL,
  "tour_id" TEXT,
  "type" TEXT DEFAULT 'club' NOT NULL,
  "venue_id" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("venue_id") REFERENCES "venues" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY ("tour_id") REFERENCES "tours" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY ("sound_engineer_id") REFERENCES "sound_engineers" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL
)
